items.title_en: Boy, 16, who has been 'living in pond' may have made condition worse by refusing to leave the water
items.title_zh: 16岁男孩一直“生活在池塘里”，拒绝离开水可能会让情况变得更糟
items.summary_en: A teenager who has spent the best part of half a decade dwelling in ponds might have been doing himself a disservice all along. Iqbal Sheikh's unorthodox way of life has been hitting international headlines over the last few weeks after footage of him immersed in a body of water went viral . The youngster, from West Bengal, India, is reportedly now receiving specialist medical care following his five-year ordeal - and it is suspected his DIY solution might have been making matters worse. Shocking videos of Sheikh…
items.summary_zh: 一个在池塘里度过了五年大半时光的青少年可能一直在伤害自己。过去几周，伊克巴尔·谢赫浸入水中的视频在网上疯传，他的非正统生活方式成为国际头条新闻。据报道，这位来自印度西孟加拉邦的年轻人在经历了五年的磨难后，现在正在接受专业医疗护理，人们怀疑他的 DIY 解决方案可能让他的生活变得更加糟糕。
